name: heyAIworld

sources.title: Wayback capture of /submit — 'Suggest AI Tool' form: Tool Name*, Website URL*, Description
Homepage — live site, but all pages gated behind Anubis anti-bot proof-of-work challenge (403 'Oh noes!' to non-JS clients)

requirements: AI-powered tools only — directory positions itself as 'a curated collection of the leading AI-powered tools, handpicked by humans'
Submission form fields: Tool Name (required), Website URL (required), Description
Curation implies editorial review; 'handpicked by humans' means acceptance is not guaranteed
preparation: Tool name and canonical website URL
A clear description of what the tool does and its main benefits
A real browser — the site runs Anubis proof-of-work anti-bot, so headless/automated form posts will fail
workflow: Open https://heyaiworld.com/ in a full browser and pass the Anubis challenge
Use the 'Submit' / 'Suggest new tool' nav link (https://heyaiworld.com/submit)
Fill Tool Name, Website URL, and Description; submit the suggestion
No account wall was visible on the archived form
watchFor: Anubis anti-bot gate on every page — scripted submissions cannot reach the form
This is a suggestion ('Suggest AI Tool'), not a guaranteed listing — editorial pick
Third-party directory trackers noted the operator asked not to be included in auto-submission lists; submit manually and respectfully
Small solo-run site (footer credits Mateusz Tylec); review cadence may be slow
countsAsLive: The tool appears in the heyAIworld tools listing / tag pages reachable from the public directory
unknowns: Whether the submit form or backend has changed since the Aug 2025 capture
